fact: Prime Minister Amadou Gon Coulibaly launched the Portail du Citoyen Miliê on 7 February 2019, a platform to collect, process and manage the concerns of users of the administration; no case numbers are given.

The CICG release names the citizen portal Miliê as an interactive platform for collecting, processing and managing users' concerns, and separately says the Observatoire du Service Public recorded over 30,000 user concerns from February 2017 to 2021, without tying that count to the portal.

The Ministry of Digital Transition issued a call on 10 November 2026, under the World Bank-financed PADCI, for a firm to digitalise the National Barometer of Public Service Quality, with web forms, offline tablets, phone surveys and USSD/SMS collection planned, after a 2024-2025 national survey run largely by hand.
